title: TwoLeadECG Q.ANT disagreement localization
research_question: Why does frozen Alpha4 retain >0.80 Q.ANT accuracy on TwoLeadECG while reference/Q.ANT prediction disagreements rise?
hypothesis: Reference/Q.ANT prediction disagreements will concentrate on low-margin TEST examples, and the ratio of absolute Q.ANT logit perturbation to reference classification margin will be substantially larger for disagreement cases than agreement cases.
scientific_boundary: Diagnostic only. The frozen Exp013 TwoLeadECG architecture and training protocol are unchanged. No architecture selection or TEST-driven tuning.
diagnostics: reference top1-minus-top2 absolute logit margin for every TEST example
maximum absolute Q.ANT-minus-reference logit perturbation per example
aggregate median margin and ratio for agreement versus disagreement cases
success_criteria: Supported if disagreement cases have both a lower median reference margin and a higher median perturbation-to-margin ratio than agreement cases when pooled across all seeds.
promotion_rule: No model promotion. Result determines whether the next intervention should target decision-margin robustness or another compatibility mechanism.
hardware_boundary: Q.ANT CPU/software simulation only; no physical photonic hardware performance claim.
